confidence: Moderately high for Paige as leading suspect; moderate overall because the vial and paper have no ownership attribution and preview attendees are not yet comprehensively timed.
plausibility_notes: New sample vial makes transport physically plausible; small sample containers were planted earlier.
Custody photographs bound tampering to preview under normal assumptions, but assistant testimony and key custody remain evidentiary dependencies.
Clean food, sauce and prop glass exclude those delivery mechanisms; they do not exclude the corresponding people.
The common paper match correctly avoids pretending to identify a person.
